title: Here’s what happened in crypto today

title: Kraken wins $22M arbitration against former auditor Mazars
summary: The crypto exchange's parent company says Mazars' withdrawal from its 2022 audit caused millions in damages and tied the dispute to Operation Chokepoint 2.0.

title: USDT wins payments, USDC wins DeFi as stablecoins diverge: Dune
summary: Dune data shows Tether's USDT has become crypto’s dominant payments stablecoin while Circle's USDC powers DeFi, highlighting how blockchain choice shapes stablecoin use.

title: Tether invests in Mercado Bitcoin as blockchain finance expands in Latin America
summary: Mercado Bitcoin will use the funding to expand tokenized finance across Latin America, adding to Tether's growing portfolio of infrastructure investments.

title: Nigel Farage to resign from UK Parliament amid crypto “gift” scandal, will stand in by-election

title: Institutional crypto exchange EDX lands $76M from SBI Holdings

title: Bitcoin Covenants part 3: SIGHASH_ANYPREVOUT
summary: APO lets a Bitcoin signature authorize any compatible UTXO rather than one fixed outpoint. It allows for rebindable pre-signed transactions for Lightning, vaults, and layer-2 protocols without new key management overhead.

title: Has Bitcoin bottomed for this cycle? Analysts say 'not yet'
summary: Some Bitcoin analysts point to a deeper downside risk, while others believes they can see the early signs of a recovery.

title: Bitcoin nears cycle bottom as over half of supply is held at a loss, says K33
summary: K33 said Bitcoin has historically bottomed within weeks of more than half of its circulating supply being held at a loss, with strong one-year returns following in most previous cycles.
